categories.name: rpc
categories.evidence: Matches the RPC/REST/ZMQ area label and updates JSON-RPC request parsing in src/rpc/request.cpp.
categories.rationale: Fixes an RPC batch error-handling bug where malformed elements can reuse the previous request's ID or omit errors entirely. In src/rpc/request.cpp, parse() reuses state across batch items, causing malformed non-object items to inherit the preceding item's ID or notification status (PR description, pinheadmz review). While fixing spec compliance for returned batch responses, this only affects malformed batch payloads and is reasonably deferrable.
